description: Tournament founding and changes, replayed by reduceTournament (lib/protocol/tournament-state.ts).
format: Events are signed (BIP-340, zero aux randomness) with keys derived as sha256('blueline-vector:' + name). Content keys, nonces and NIP-44 nonces are fixed. Expected outcomes are written by hand from docs/protocol.

cases.name: registration-and-admission
cases.description: Registrations wait for the organizer, whatever their created_at: P4 dated hers before everyone and still waits. The organizer admits two, the third admission is refused (full), puts two on the waiting list and later admits P4 from it, not P3. A late registration during check-in waits, marked late.

cases.name: capacity
cases.description: Three places: a fourth guest and an admission beyond capacity are refused, a tournament without a waiting list has none, and the capacity cannot shrink below the admitted field.

cases.name: guests-and-claims
cases.description: The organizer adds guests: one under a neutral alias, one who agreed to be shown by name. A guest place is linked to a player only after that player claimed it; only the organizer adds guests.

cases.name: checkin-and-draw
cases.description: Check-in, then the draw opens the seed committed at the founding and fixes the field. A wrong seed, a field with someone who never registered or whom the organizer took out, and a second draw without a new commitment are refused.

cases.name: draw-holds-against-backdated-player-records
cases.description: Players date their own records. P2 dates a withdrawal before the organizer admitted her and P3 one just before the draw: the admission of P2 is refused, but the organizer's draw, which includes both, still stands; both are withdrawn (walkovers for the engine).

cases.name: boards-and-results
cases.description: Boards submit results only for slots assigned to them; the organizer approves and corrects. A walkover is a result too. A correction marks the next match built on it as affected.

cases.name: organizer-handover
cases.description: The organization changes only by offer and acceptance. Afterwards the former organizer's decisions are refused.

cases.name: former-organizer-backdates
cases.description: The new organizer's acceptance names the core state they took over. The former organizer later dates a cancellation and a withdrawal of the accepted offer back into their tenure: both are superseded, and the new organizer's draw and start stand. Places are not pinned: a guest the former organizer dates back still counts (documented limit, conflicts.md).

cases.name: handover-cancel-then-expired-accept
cases.description: Rule Ü2 b: the organizer withdraws the offer and keeps running the tournament. Organizer 2 accepts after the offer expired: no hand-over, and nothing of the organizer's is cut.

cases.name: handover-completed-then-old-offer-accepted
cases.description: Rules Ü3 and Ü4: the organizer withdraws the offer to organizer 2 and hands over to organizer 3, who accepts first. Organizer 2's later acceptance of the withdrawn offer (still inside its time) answers an offer of someone who no longer organizes: organizer 3 stays.

cases.name: handover-accept-names-older-core
cases.description: Rule Ü2 c: the offer hands over the running tournament (core = the start). Organizer 2 accepts naming the founding instead, to cut the draw, the start and the result: refused. A second, correct acceptance is not an answer any more (Ü3), so organizer 2's new seed and draw are refused and the draw stands.

cases.name: handover-crossing-cancel
cases.description: Rules Ü5 and Ü6 a (known limit): the offer hands over the renamed tournament. The organizer withdraws it and renames again; organizer 2 accepts inside the offer's time without having seen either. The acceptance ends the tenure: the withdrawal and the second rename are cut, the first rename (handed over) stays.

cases.name: later-offer-on-stale-base
cases.description: Rules Ü4 and Ü5: organizer 2 takes over, then offers the organization on an outdated base (the first offer instead of their own acceptance). That offer is a visible conflict and its acceptance does not hold; since an end only reaches back to the start of the outgoing tenure, it cannot cut the acceptance that began it: organizer 2 stays.

cases.name: rules-locked-and-unknown
cases.description: Rules cannot change once drawn, details can. A registration in a newer format version is kept, not executed.

cases.name: club-tournament
cases.description: A club's tournament: founded by a director of the club. Handing the organization to a plain member of the club is refused.

cases.name: club-tournament-by-member
cases.description: A plain member cannot found a tournament for the club.

cases.name: newer-engine
cases.description: A tournament built with newer bracket rules is kept, never run with today's rules.
